tasks.title: Searchsploit: Find & Retrieve Exploits
tasks.description: Search the local ExploitDB mirror by service/version/CVE, then copy the matching exploit into your working directory instead of running it from /usr/share — copies are safer to edit (IP/port placeholders) and keep loot organized per host.

tasks.title: Metasploit: Searching for Modules
tasks.description: Search msfconsole's module database by name, CVE, platform, or type before assuming you need a manual exploit.

tasks.title: Metasploit: Select a Module & Payload
tasks.description: Load a module, list compatible payloads, and set one before configuring the rest of the options. `show payloads` only lists payloads valid for the currently loaded module/target.

tasks.title: Metasploit: Set Up a Multi/Handler
tasks.description: Use this when the payload was generated externally (e.g. msfvenom) and you just need something in msfconsole to catch the callback — the payload here must exactly match what was generated (type, arch, LHOST/LPORT).

tasks.title: Reverse Shell Generator (revshells.com)
tasks.description: Auto-generates reverse shell one-liners (bash, python, php, powershell, nc, msfvenom, etc.) for a given IP/port — faster than hand-writing one when the target's available interpreters are unclear.

tasks.title: Pentestmonkey Reverse Shell Cheat Sheet
tasks.description: Reference list of reverse shell one-liners per language/interpreter, useful as a fallback when revshells.com doesn't cover an unusual interpreter.

tasks.title: GTFOBins
tasks.description: Lookup table of Unix binaries that can be abused to bypass local security restrictions (shell breakout, file read/write, privesc) via SUID, sudo, or capabilities.

tasks.title: LOLBAS
tasks.description: Windows equivalent of GTFOBins — living-off-the-land binaries, scripts, and libraries usable for download, execution, or privesc without dropping extra tooling.

tasks.title: HackTricks
tasks.description: Broad technique reference covering enumeration, privesc, and AD attacks across both Windows and Linux — good second opinion when the built-in methodology doesn't cover an edge case.

tasks.title: CyberChef
tasks.description: Browser-based swiss-army-knife for encoding/decoding/hashing/crypto (base64, URL, hex, XOR, JWT, etc.) — useful for anything more involved than the built-in Base64 tool handles.

tasks.title: PayloadsAllTheThings
tasks.description: Large reference of payloads and bypass techniques across injection classes (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, command injection, file upload, etc.).

tasks.title: Pentestmonkey SQL Injection Cheat Sheets
tasks.description: Database-specific SQLi syntax reference (MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) for building blind/UNION-based payloads by hand.
